name: FINAL BOSS
summary:
You cut someone off in traffic this morning. You forgot about it by
lunch. He didn't.

Twenty floors. One stairwell. Every idiot who ruined your day is
waiting on it.

FINAL BOSS is a comedic first-person brawler about punching your way
up a building full of people holding a grudge. The guy who parked you
in. The security guard who won't let you take the elevator. Your old
boss. And at the top, the man you cut off — who spent the entire day
organizing everyone else into a coordinated pursuit.

**STORY MODE*
